system.description:
You may use this skill if your sub class is Forager, Miner, Frontier Guard, or Trader.

You may make one roll on [Treasure Table: Magic Reagents]. 

(Connection: Freeman, Cartographer): You gain a +4 bonus to the roll.
(Connection: Explorer, Hunter): You gain a +4 bonus to the roll.

A skill that allows you to collect magical materials through various methods such as gathering, searching, and trading.
